title: Tim Taylor at the Anderson case dig: 'This is the real deal'

tellings.quote: go to this dig and Tim's getting this stuff and I remember my friend said Tim said when some of the stuff came up, "This is the real deal."

plain: In 2013, at a dig at a site tied to a reported UFO crash known as the Anderson case, a man named Timothy Taylor saw material come out of the ground and said, "This is the real deal." A guest named Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something a friend of his told him. If true, the dig turned up something Taylor believed was genuine crash material.
